_doc: Oracle-text UNCOVERED whitelist (formerly fidelity-uncovered-allowlist). STATELESS INVARIANT: a gold whose card is absent from BOTH the corpus AND the full Scryfall bulk cannot be validated against any authoritative source — loud failure UNLESS named here. These are genuinely irreducible (playtest/un-cards/variants with no Scryfall oracle entry). tag irreducible. A listed gold whose card later appears in either source fails (remove it — it now gets real validation).
